sources.construction: Pebbled dark whole fruit behind a pale pear-shaped half, broad buttery flesh and large warm irregular pit.
Asymmetric bent peel with flattened longitudinal facets, bruised cut stem, blossom tip and sparse ripening flecks.
Uneven dense multi-lobed crown, selective bud marks, shadowed floret joins and fibrous forked pale stalk.
Irregular scalloped browned albumen edge, translucent folded white washes and warm off-center domed yolk.
Dimpled whole fruit with leaf behind an oblique cut hemisphere; uneven radial pulp segments separated by pale pith.
Tapered oblique fillet with distinct thickness, branching variable-width fat seams, translucent flesh and a narrow scaly silver-green skin edge.
